About

I am a graduate student in physics at the International Centre for Theoretical Sciences (ICTS-TIFR). I completed my undergraduate studies at BITS Pilani, Goa Campus. My research interests lie broadly in understanding physics at the smallest and largest length scales.

Outside of academia, I enjoy swimming, painting, listening to rock music, and sharing memes.

Research

Gravitation · Quantum field theory · Holography

01

Post-Newtonian dynamics in (A)dS and dual CFT data

How does AdS/CFT dictionary work for the most familiar gravitational system: two massive bodies bound by a nearly Newtonian potential? In this project we study the post-Newtonian dynamics of an inspiralling binary in Anti de-Sitter/de-Sitter background. We also extract information about the dual boundary field theory (CFT). In dS, this analysis gives us cosmological curvature corrections to gravitational-wave data.

Current directions
  • Conservative dynamics and conserved charges through 2PN.
  • Effective one-body dynamics and quasi-circular orbits.
  • CFT data from bulk energy spectrum and boundary waveform.
  • Gravitational radiation and radiation reaction in AdS
02

Soft theorems and gauge invariance

Soft theorems describe infrared properties of gauge theories. How do they get modified when the gauge invariance is non-trivial: as in the case of Chern–Simons gauge theories? We studied soft theorems for gauge theories with Chern-Simons perturbations in both flat and curved (de Sitter) background.

Current directions
  • Soft theorems for Chern-Simons in flat spacetime
  • Loop corrections to tree-level Chern-Simons soft factors
  • Curvature corrections (or lack of) to Chern-Simons soft factors
  • Connections to asymptotic symmetries
